panel.summary: Formula read-only guard is a parity/UX guard, not an enforced write boundary — other write paths still overwrite a formula-backed checkbox cell
panel.evidence: `toggleCheckboxAt` now returns false when `cell?.f` is set, but this is not an access-control boundary: `Sheet.setData` (and paste/fill/removeData) remain reachable for the same ref with no equivalent check, so the cell's formula is still overwritable by ordinary edits. I enumerated every caller of `toggleCheckboxAt` (view/spreadsheet.ts:363, view/worksheet.ts:3405 click path, view/worksheet.ts:4853 Space path) and each is already gated on `this.readOnly`/`this._readOnly` before reaching the model, so the change neither adds nor weakens a permission gate. Flagging only so the guard is not later read as an authorization control; no bypass of an existing security gate found.
